# Morphogenetic_Growth

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network construction method where topology emerges from developmental rules rather than being explicitly designed, mimicking biological tissue growth. Enables scalable, self-organizing neuromorphic architectures that can adapt their physical structure to computational demands.
